subject: FinTechCo pricing follow-up: regional costs & residency (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@fintechco.com>, Luca Romano <luca.romano@fintechco.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: FinTechCo pricing follow-up: regional costs & residency (post-discovery)

Hi Emma / Luca —

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to understand FinTechCo's usage patterns and residency needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a scoped pricing estimate over to you: 

Recap (from our notes):
- Workloads: conversational assistants (customer support chat) + embeddings for search/ranking.
- Expected steady-state volume: ~40–60M tokens/day peak for chat, ~20M embedding tokens/day (ballpark).
- Burst/day events: up to ~120M tokens for promotional campaigns (1–2x/week).
- Data residency: EU residency required for all customer PII; non-PII inference can be served from US or multi-region.
- Target procurement cadence: decision in 2–3 weeks; likely procurement via central IT.

Pricing asks we discussed (please confirm):
1) Target unit economics you’d like to hit (e.g., $ per 1M tokens) — you mentioned a target range on the call; can you confirm?
2) Confirm monthly committed token volume range (min/max) so I can model hosted vs reserved (Dedicated) options.
3) Residency requirement scope: strict EU-only for all inference, or EU-only for PII paths?

What I’ll send: Sean and I will prepare a two-slide pricing model and an attached workbook showing: hosted vs dedicated costs, per-region differentials (US vs EU), and an estimate of the budget range for the volumes you gave. Sean will flag where reserved capacity materially reduces $/1M tokens.

Next steps / ask from you:
- Please reply with a confirmed monthly token estimate range (low/nominal/high) and whether EU residency is required for all traffic or only PII.
- If you can share rough monthly budget range (ballpark ok), that will help us tailor the proposal.

Attaching: pricing_estimate workbook (draft). I’ll follow up with a walk-through and a short quote.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@fintechco.com>

Cc: Luca Romano <luca.romano@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCo pricing follow-up: regional costs & residency (post-discovery)

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Monthly volumes (rough):
  - Chat completions: 900M–1.8B tokens/month (nominal ~1.2B)
  - Embeddings (indexing + user queries): 400M–800M tokens/month (nominal ~550M)
  - Bursts: expect up to 4B tokens in a high-marketing campaign month (rare).
- Residency: EU residency is required for any inference that involves customer-identifiable data (PII). Non-PII inference may live in US. We will need contract language and technical details for audit.
- Budget: we’re aiming for an annualized price that averages roughly $120–$180 per 1M chat tokens (this is a target range across host/dedicated options). Embeddings pricing we expect to be lower per effective token, but please model both separately.

Questions for you:
1) Can Redwood split routing so PII requests are pinned to EU hosts while non-PII routes go to US (to control costs)?
2) What is the estimated EU premium vs US for hosted inference (percentage)?

We can do a quick 30-min follow-up tomorrow morning if that helps — 09:30–10:00CET works for Luca and me.

—Emma
Emma Johnson
Head of ML Ops, FinTechCo
emma.johnson@fintechco.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@fintechco.com>, Luca Romano <luca.romano@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T18:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCo pricing follow-up: regional costs & residency (post-discovery)

Marissa / team — looping in a quick pricing sketch per Emma's numbers. High-level bullets (rough, will refine in workbook):

- Routing: Yes — we support policy-based routing. PII-tagged requests can be routed to EU-only hosts (Private or Dedicated), while non-PII can be served from US for lower cost. This is standard for our customers.
- Unit economics (hosted, list prices, approximate):
  - US hosted (chat): ~$90 per 1M tokens (base list)
  - EU hosted (chat): ~US price * 1.20 => ~$108 per 1M tokens (region premium ~20%)
  - Embeddings: ~40–60% of chat price per effective 1M tokens depending on model and quantization.
- Reserved (Dedicated) commitments: with a 12–24 month reserved pool and committed throughput, we can typically reduce effective $/1M tokens by ~30–45% depending on size and burst profile.
- Cost drivers: model choice (large-chat vs compressed quant models), KV caching effectiveness, prefix reuse, and burst provisioning. We'll show sensitivity to those in the attached workbook.

Action: I've attached the draft pricing workbook (same filename Marissa used) and a short slide that models three scenarios: hosted-only US-centric, hosted with EU pinned PII, and dedicated hybrid (EU reserved for PII + US reserved/hosted mix).

Emma — I'll keep the EU premium conservative at 20% in the workbook; we can tighten after procurement details.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Sr Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

3) Can we schedule the 30-min follow-up tomorrow at 09:30 CET? Please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite (I'll include a link to the HubSpot record and the draft quote).
